newsitem.title: UK: Oman's debut dollar Eurobond due this week - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Oman's debut dollar Eurobond due this week - dealers.

text.p: The Sultanate of Oman's debut international Eurobond -- expected to be a $150 million five-year offering -- should surface this week in spite of wider spreads in emerging market paper, sources close to the deal said on Monday.
J.P. Morgan is lead manager for the transaction.
Last September, Oman raised $400 million in the international loan market. The seven-year transaction was increased from $300 million after being oversubscribed.
At the time of the loan, a finance ministry official said the money would be used to fund development projects.
Oman is rated BBB minus by Standard & Poor's Corp.
